facts.value: French Economics 1 - Foundation

In the course French Economics 1 - Foundation, you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language, as well as insights into the country, its society, and topics relevant to business life, such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
Unit 1 – Consumer Behavior, Unit 2 – Company Structure, Unit 3 – Financing a Project
13 double hours, including final exam
90 Euro
Oral participation and presentation, written exam in the last lecture week. A graded certificate will be awarded for successfully passing the exams.
